comment: Differences between the native executor and the JiuwenSwarm executor that were looked at and judged acceptable. Each rule names the case, the step and the path, and says why. run.mjs --compare lists them as accepted; --strict fails on them too. Adding a rule to make a comparison pass needs a human review.

rules.reason: the errorCode is the same (unauthorized); the text is each executor's own wording of the provider's 401

GAP, not a preference: the native agent attaches evidence (agentRunId, contextRef, stateRef) to every event and records context.captured/state.committed/model.completed; the JiuwenSwarm executor produces none of it, so the trajectory view of such a run has nothing to show
